variables.name: --sl-toast-index
variables.reason: ToastStack writes each toast's stack index to ToastAppear; this runtime value determines stacking and is not a design token.

variables.name: --sl-table-grid-template-columns
variables.reason: Table converts the optional columnWidths prop to a grid template on its root. When absent, CSS uses the property's initial behavior; browser coverage must verify both states.

variables.name: --sl-element-height
variables.reason: IconButton composes Button and consumes Button's size-dependent element height. The provider stylesheet must be present in every consuming theme.

variables.name: --sl-element-space-top
variables.reason: Drawer and Modal headers align nested buttons using the padding properties supplied by Button and IconButton. DOM composition and size coverage remain browser-test obligations.

variables.name: --sl-element-space-bottom
variables.reason: Drawer and Modal headers align nested buttons using the padding properties supplied by Button and IconButton. DOM composition and size coverage remain browser-test obligations.

variables.name: --sl-element-space-right
variables.reason: ModalDismiss aligns the dismiss button using Button and IconButton right padding; this is an explicit component-composition dependency, not a global theme token.
